title: Work tape count bounded by space
statement: Let $N$ be a finite nondeterministic Turing machine with $k$ work tapes, and let $s\colon\mathbb{N}\to\mathbb{N}$. Suppose that for every Boolean input $x$ and every choice word $w$, the total number of work tape cells visited along the run from the initial configuration on $x$ is at most $s(|x|)$. Then $k\le s(n)$ for every $n\in\mathbb{N}$.
hypotheses_covered: $N$ is a finite nondeterministic Turing machine over Boolean symbols
For every Boolean input $x$ and choice word $w$, space used is at most $s(|x|)$
